parameters.content:
## Bulk enrich business prospects with OpenMart and prioritize outreach in Google Sheets

### How it works

This workflow reads a bulk prospect list from a Google Sheets **Businesses** tab, validates and deduplicates enabled rows, checks the OpenMart credit balance, and starts paid company-email and decision-maker research. It safely polls each background job, extracts available contacts, ranks every business by outreach readiness, and creates a dated Google Sheets report.

### Setup steps

- Connect an OpenMart API credential to every OpenMart node.
- Connect a Google Sheets OAuth2 credential to all Google Sheets nodes.
- Create a **Businesses** tab with columns: enabled, company_name, website, city, state, country, decision_maker_titles, max_contacts.
- Enter the source spreadsheet URL and tab name in **Set Bulk Research Settings**.
- Review the batch cap and defaults, then set confirmPaidEnrichment to true only when ready to spend credits.

### Customization

Only company_name and website are required. Blank optional cells use the defaults from the settings node. Set enabled to false, no, 0, disabled, or skip to exclude a row. Change the default titles and location for any market, or override them per business.

Paid creation nodes intentionally have no automatic retries because rerunning can create duplicate charged work. Safe Batch and Task reads retry transient failures. The workflow sends no outreach and does not add records to a CRM.

## Configure and confirm bulk research

Defines the source spreadsheet, reusable defaults, batch cap and polling delays, then requires explicit confirmation before any paid job can start.

## Read and validate spreadsheet input

Reads the Businesses tab, skips disabled rows, validates required fields, removes duplicate domains, applies per-row overrides and checks the OpenMart credit balance.

## Prepare business records

Splits the approved batch and exposes normalized fields used by both paid OpenMart operations.

## Find shared company emails

Starts one paid shared-inbox discovery job per selected business without enabling automatic retries.

## Find relevant decision-makers

Starts one paid people-discovery job per business using the configured titles and optional location.

## Wait and check job readiness

Combines both job types, processes batches sequentially, waits once, and performs the first safe status check.

## Retry the status check once

Waits a second configurable interval for unfinished work, checks readiness again, and records a timeout instead of polling forever.

## Retrieve completed task IDs

Retrieves the task ID from either successful status branch and preserves the matching company and job context.

## Extract usable contact data

Retrieves each task, extracts emails, phones, people and LinkedIn links, and records empty results without stopping the remaining jobs.

## Rank outreach readiness

Combines both OpenMart jobs per business and assigns an actionable A-through-D contactability priority.

## Create the Google Sheets report

Creates a dated spreadsheet, expands the ranked businesses into rows, and appends a review-ready contact research table.

## Summarize the research run

Reports the spreadsheet URL, processed count, useful email coverage and the starting credit balance.
